create_markersets_editor: create a MarkerSetsEditor instance with a habitat_sim Simulator to manage marker sets on scene objects
place_marker_at_hit_location: place or remove a marker at a raycast hit location on a rigid or articulated object
get_all_markersets: get all markersets defined on rigid and articulated objects currently loaded in the simulator scene
save_all_dirty_markersets: save all modified markersets to disk by persisting their attributes to the object template manager
draw_marker_sets_debug: draw all configured marker sets as colored circles in the debug line renderer for visualization
